# Asset provenance and licensing

**Summary: every asset in this game is original work generated by code in this
repository. There are no third-party assets, and therefore no third-party
licence obligations, attribution requirements or commercial-use restrictions.**

This document exists to make that auditable rather than to ask you to take it on
trust.

---

## Verifying the claim

The repository contains no binary asset files. This is checkable:

```bash
# Should list only .gd, .gdshader, .tscn, .cfg, .md, .json, .svg files
git ls-files | sed 's/.*\.//' | sort -u
```

The only image file in the repository is `icon.svg`, which is hand-written SVG
authored for this project (a stylised pine over a dark field) and is covered by
the project's MIT licence.

---

## Where each class of asset comes from

| Asset class | Produced by | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Terrain, trees, undergrowth, rocks | `scripts/core/mesh_factory.gd` | `SurfaceTool` geometry; three LODs for pines |
| Structures, props, furniture | `scripts/core/mesh_factory.gd` | Composed from boxes, tapered cylinders and swept quads |
| Creature and character meshes | `scripts/core/mesh_factory.gd` | Blocked-out parts articulated by node hierarchies |
| Ground, bark, plank, metal, stone textures | `scripts/core/texture_factory.gd` | `FastNoiseLite` fBm, cellular and fibre variants |
| Foliage alpha masks | `scripts/core/texture_factory.gd` | Rasterised needle and blade shapes |
| Water normal map | `scripts/core/texture_factory.gd` | Height field via `Image.bump_map_to_normal_map` |
| Fog, rain, light cookie, paper | `scripts/core/texture_factory.gd` | Analytic gradients plus noise |
| Sky | `shaders/sky.gdshader` | Fully procedural: gradient, sun, moon, stars, clouds |
| Ambience (wind, rain, water, insects, room tone) | `scripts/core/audio_synth.gd` | Filtered noise beds with slow modulation |
| Footsteps, creaks, impacts, thunder | `scripts/core/audio_synth.gd` | Band-passed noise and swept resonators |
| Whispers and horror sounds | `scripts/core/audio_synth.gd` | Three-formant filtered noise with syllable gating |
| Wildlife calls | `scripts/core/audio_synth.gd` | Wavetable oscillators with per-species envelopes |
| Music | `scripts/core/audio_synth.gd` | Four cross-faded drone stems, D minor material |
| UI theme, fonts | `scripts/ui/ui_theme.gd` | Theme built in code; uses Godot's built-in default font |
| Writing (story, documents, item text) | `data/`, `docs/STORY.md` | Original prose written for this project |

---

## Third-party components

| Component | Licence | Obligation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Godot Engine 4.6 | MIT | Attribution in distributed builds. Godot's own splash/licence screen satisfies this; the licence text is also reproduced in `docs/BUILD.md`. |
| Godot's default UI font (Open Sans subset, bundled with the engine) | Apache 2.0 | Bundled and licensed by the engine itself. |

Nothing else is vendored. There is no `addons/` directory.

---

## If you add an asset later

The brief permits Kenney, Quaternius, Poly Haven, OpenGameArt, Sketchfab and
the Godot Asset Library where properly licensed. If a future change introduces
any such asset, add a row here recording: file path, source URL, author,
licence, licence URL, and the date it was retrieved — and keep the licence text
itself under `docs/licenses/`. A CC0 asset still needs its provenance recorded,
because "we believed it was CC0" is not a defence if it turns out not to be.

The build is currently free of that obligation entirely, and it is worth
weighing what a single imported asset costs before giving that up: it adds a
download to a mobile-first build, an import step, and a licence surface.
